descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S27 Stale content after a failure, both contexts: yesterday's panels and yesterday's note are never shown as today's, and a failed note shows an explicit error on the Note tab

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3b Yesterday's panels are never silently reused: while today's summary has failed, and after its retry, a value from yesterday is either absent or shown with its date, never as today's. (TFA-92588 AC 8 (second sentence); UAT 3.7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U4b When note generation fails, the Note tab shows an explicit error state, never a blank or fabricated note, and never an earlier note presented as today's. (TFA-92595 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital chart P with yesterday's processed panels (vitals and labs refreshed 20 h ago: BP 150/90, Creatinine 1.2) and yesterday's note (generated 20 h ago, kept as the previous note); a Nursing Home resident Q with the last visit's panels (BP 140/88, Albumin 3.1) and note. …

When On P / Q: type today's pre-round and press Save Note (fails), look at the panels; press Save Note again (succeeds), look at the panels; type today's encounter, press Generate Note & Finish (fails), open the Note tab. …

Then While today's summary has failed and after its retry, yesterday's values are either absent or shown with their date, never as today's; after the retry today's values show. After the failed Generate the Note tab shows an explicit failure ('not generated'), not the empty 'no note yet' card, and yesterday's note is never in the current-note slot (it may show l …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U3b and U4b, gated (failures report as Blocked: TFA-92588 / TFA-92595). Panel checkpoints: datedIfShown — each of yesterday's values may appear only on a line that also carries its date or 'yesterday' / 'last visit'; after the retry mustContain today's values. Note-tab checkpoints mustContain 'not generated' (the U4b failure state; …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
